result.summary: Found 2 issues: a broken discount label and an inconsistent favorite icon style.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card displays a '-0%' discount badge, which represents a meaningless zero-percent discount, likely a data or formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0%, or display the correct promotional value.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon styling is inconsistent between cards. The ramen card shows a light/white circular heart button while the pizza card shows a dark circular heart button.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and color across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
